report_meta.executive_summary: Shannon's exploitation phase confirmed a DOM XSS in the search results rendering path.

findings.title: DOM XSS in search results rendering via unescaped query parameter
findings.overview: Shannon's exploitation phase confirmed that the `q` query parameter is read via URLSearchParams and written into the results container's innerHTML without encoding, allowing arbitrary script execution in the victim's browser.
findings.impact: Arbitrary JavaScript executes in the context of any user who follows a crafted link.
findings.remediation: Use textContent (or an encoding-aware render path) instead of innerHTML for the results container.

items.text: Send /search?q= to the victim.

proof_of_impact.text: The onerror handler executed in the victim's browser.
